cases.causalCard: Local executor proves its process. Native external authority proves outside occurrence. Missing response preserves UNKNOWN; safe recovery reconciles the original effect identity.
cases.compactExplanation: Local execution evidence does not prove an uncontrolled external effect. Preserve UNKNOWN and reconcile through the native consequence authority.

options.A: External occurrence truth is lost because Runtime was its owner.
options.B: Only local execution lineage is lost; external truth still belongs to the provider, so reconcile the retained provider identity rather than infer or blindly retry.
options.C: Nothing material is lost because external effects are always idempotent.
options.D: Host may reconstruct the exact external occurrence from Task history.
